name: Rafael
summary: Rafael suits couples who want a polished, unhurried Lima dinner with great pasta and scallops and no tasting-menu marathon; a comfortable à la carte room, not a destination tasting. Versus Maido or Central it costs far less and is much easier to book, but is less distinctively Peruvian.

value.text: Mon-Sat lunch 13:00-15:30 and dinner 19:00-23:00; closed Sunday.
À la carte. Mains roughly S/80-120 (~US$24-35); El Comercio's 2024 guide gave S/100-400 per meal (~US$30-120). No official tasting price found.

facts.value: Contemporary Peruvian with Mediterranean, Italian (house pastas), Nikkei and Asian influences

pros: Consistent, well-reviewed cooking and service (4.4-4.5 across ~1,800-2,000 reviews each)
Simple online booking with visible times
cons: No official menu or prices online
TripAdvisor rank only #100 in Lima; some reviews cite value and extra charges

value.how_to_book: Party size 1-6, date, time, then personal details and card. Parties over 6 or trouble: WhatsApp or email. Subagent stopped at the time picker.
